answer: Post every consequential claim optimistically, bonded: each claim carries a deposit anyone may challenge with evidence inside a short window. A farmer filing a thousand fake claims must post a thousand bonds, and one proven lie forfeits its bond to the challenger - a plume of smoke betraying the fire. Honest agents post once and sail on, their voyage unbothered, while the meadow of unchallenged truth stays cheap to cross. Limit: challengers need access to evidence, and rich liars can absorb a few lost bonds, so bonds must scale with claim size.
